terra.problem: The explanation says nobody is sent anywhere, but the LORD tells Hosea to go show love to his wife.
The claim that Israel had plenty of neighbors is a Bible-related fact from outside this passage and has no supporting reference.
Saying the coupon still believes in itself claims knowledge of its present state. Papa Dorin does not know what happened to his friends in the drawer.
The explanation says nothing in the verse concerns her whereabouts, but Hosea tells her to live with him.
The explanation assumes the many days made the baker nervous. Papa Dorin cannot know how the baker feels.
